benchmark.representative_denominator: Last of three batches at each of four static configurations, plus all three moving configurations; five measured repeats give 35 samples per variant/filter mode.
benchmark.processing_order: Alternated by full-pass parity; each variant sees unchanged original order.
benchmark.capture_annotation_correction: Original capture manifest omitted the index-12 moving-sequence reset annotation. Replay follows the unchanged V2 fixture; the original capture manifest and script remain unmodified.
benchmark.clock_scope: Explicit original acquisition timeline; excludes live acquisition, pose-history callbacks and real completion-age acceptance.
benchmark.acquisition: Exact existing two-camera frames borrowed once per batch; no new render or retimestamp in replay.
benchmark.timed_update_scope: Source/session update only, including selected-pixel filtering and recorded pose-instance assembly; loading, BVH initialization, full-state equality hashes, snapshot/query, profiler and memory instrumentation are excluded.

controlled_mapping.equality_scope: Whole-grid states, probabilities, observed/last_observed/expired arrays, source timestamp, revision, generation, health, counts and 1000 deterministic query results; exact selected masks and pixel selections. Hash comparisons cover complete array bytes, not only counts.

semantic_and_combined.scope: Measured sequential semantic then filtered mapping on identical full-arm frames; frozen semantic code throughout. This is not generalized tabletop latency or asynchronous control latency.
semantic_and_combined.semantic_source: Unchanged working-tree implementation for all three scheduling modes.
semantic_and_combined.output_signature_scope: Classes, persistent IDs, poses, sizes, primitive geometry, confidence, graspable/readiness, observation and geometry metadata, and original timestamps; identical frozen semantic implementation in every mode.

profiles.scope: Separate instrumented fresh-state Home update at recorded index2. Line/cProfile overhead is excluded from every headline median/p95/max.

raw_line_attribution.scope: Single representative fresh-state update with line tracing. Nested expiry overlaps integration; scalar traversal includes per-visit insertion. Excluded from headline latency.
Single representative fresh-state update with line tracing. Nested expiry overlaps integration; scalar traversal includes per-visit insertion. Excluded from headline latency.

category_scopes.1_acquisition_and_validation: Replay line attribution measures recorded-frame validation only. Actual paired camera acquisition is measured separately in the native live check.
category_scopes.2_candidate_selection: Depth sampling, valid/manual-mask candidates, deterministic fair allocation and selected-pixel construction.
category_scopes.3_robot_geometry_and_masks: Exact triangle masks and captured pose-instance assembly; ongoing native pose-history capture is a separate counter.
category_scopes.4_world_projection: Calibrated optical rays, depth multiplication, affine world endpoints and endpoint grid indices.
category_scopes.5_ray_traversal: Finite clipped DDA cell visits. Scalar baseline includes per-visit set insertion in this attribution; bounded batched traversal is separate from its later NumPy dedup.
category_scopes.6_accumulation_and_dedup: Per-view/global evidence merging and occupied-wins dedup. Includes index conversion and a few completion checks.
category_scopes.7_probabilistic_integration: OccupancyMap.integrate and evidence/timestamp publication; contains its own nested expiry calls.
category_scopes.8_expiry_and_dense_operations: expiry_nested_and_session_ms includes session expiry and expiry nested inside integration. It overlaps category7 and must not be summed as an extra disjoint stage.
category_scopes.9_snapshot_and_queries: Normal uninstrumented full-grid immutable snapshot and 1000-point query timing reported separately in controlled_mapping.summary.

original_hotspot.finding: Scalar _ray_voxels accounts for about 92% of profiled RgbdMapper.update; 147009 traversal visits generate over 3.4 million Python function calls. Integration is about 29 ms, expiration about 8 ms; these are secondary to traversal.

workers.scope: Fresh SDK-free process per variant; RSS includes all captured inputs, cached geometry/BVH and map. Tracemalloc update is separately instrumented and not timed.
Fresh SDK-free process per variant; RSS includes all captured inputs, cached geometry/BVH and map. Tracemalloc update is separately instrumented and not timed.

memory.scope: Fresh SDK-free process per variant; process RSS includes all recorded inputs, immutable geometry/BVH and the map. Separate tracemalloc update reports allocation pressure and is excluded from latency. RSS peaks can reflect prior BVH construction; resident before/after captures are also retained.

live_native_default_freshness.ground_truth_scope: Unchanged full-arm Isaac reference mapper in this native scene; timings include stage access and dense evidence replacement.

metric_scopes.dense_stride: Independent instance-ID reference on every stride-8 valid depth pixel; pixel-frame counts sum over configurations.
metric_scopes.production_selected: Exact fairly selected mapping pixels; voxel counts deduplicate within each configuration, then sum across configurations.
metric_scopes.false_free: GT-occupied probe centers and instance-labeled surface voxel references only; not a complete volumetric certificate.
metric_scopes.moving_robot_occupancy: Historical robot-reference cells in GT environment FREE; includes current robot volume, not only vacated cells.

rejected_filter_cache_probe.modification: Research-only static edge norms and leaf slices; production robot_filter.py unchanged.
rejected_filter_cache_probe.scope: Offline CPU only; original camera/pose inputs and selected1024rays; excludes load/build; includes exact mask assertion.
rejected_filter_cache_probe.reason: About 3.2ms/1.8% median improvement is marginal beside the validated traversal change; avoid permanent cache complexity.

profile.scope: Separate cProfile pass. Cumulative values overlap and include profiler overhead.

native_fixture_comparison.scope: Same native scene, settings and seven configurations, fresh independent buffers. Identical-buffer equality is separately established by controlled replay.
